formal_hypothesis_policy.reason: Step1 freezes observability and learning-mechanism requirements before implementation. Exact successor architecture, loss equations, intervention bounds, and formal performance hypotheses must be frozen at Step2 before any source modification or training.

mandatory_observability.missingness_rule: A required diagnostic that is absent must be reported NOT_AVAILABLE; it may not be reconstructed by retraining after formal results are exposed.
mandatory_observability.persistence_rule: Diagnostics must be written to machine-readable artifacts during the run; terminal-only evidence is insufficient.

next_step.name: Step2 exact utility-supervision and selector-learning mechanism contract

G1_counterfactual_target_contract.requirement: A deterministic tensor-contract test must verify p_ref_true, p_candidate_true, delta_u, and u_target shapes, finiteness, range, detach semantics, and target-transform directionality.

G2_non_neutral_supervision_smoke.minimum_requirement: at least one positive-utility and one negative-utility case with abs(delta_u) >= 0.01
G2_non_neutral_supervision_smoke.requirement: A synthetic or controlled regression must demonstrate that positive and negative counterfactual utility cases produce directionally distinct u_target values around the neutral point.

G3_real_one_batch_learning_path.requirement: Using the real training code path, one controlled batch must demonstrate finite non-zero utility loss, non-zero selector optimization signal, and measurable selector parameter movement when non-neutral targets are present.

G4_effective_weight_assertion.requirement: The runtime must assert the effective utility/calibration/classification weights actually applied by the optimizer path, not merely the CLI/config values.

G5_inactive_by_default_gate.requirement: Before learned evidence satisfies the prospectively frozen intervention rule, the selector must preserve the stable-reference/no-intervention default.

L2_candidate_action_quality.candidate_space_failure_rule: beneficial fraction < 0.40 AND harmful fraction >= beneficial fraction
required_metrics: mean positive delta_u conditional on benefit
mean negative delta_u conditional on harm
selector gradient norm or equivalent optimization signal
L4_selector_optimization.selector_nonlearning_rule: final utility_probability std < 0.02 AND active intervention rate == 0
